description: This file contains CLI command definitions for managing teams in the LiteLLM application, including listing, displaying available teams, and assigning API keys to teams.

classes.name: Client
classes.description: Client class for interacting with the LiteLLM API, used for listing teams, getting available teams, and updating keys.

methods.name: display_teams_table
methods.description: Displays a list of teams in a formatted table.

methods.name: list
methods.description: CLI command to list teams the user belongs to.

methods.name: available
methods.description: CLI command to list teams available to join.

methods.name: assign_key
methods.description: CLI command to assign the current API key to a specified team.
